scenario: [LCAP.2.1.5]: `realtime` is not part of this edition, so a `use` block line setting it `true` is refused with DS_VALIDATE_REALTIME_DEFERRED, at the line ([LDIA.3.3.7]). The dialect is `default` and the block sets `constspace: true` as well, so the fundamental constraint of [LCAP.3.8] cannot be what fails, and the program has no sibling `.dsrt`: a compiler that still admits the setting reports DS_VALIDATE_COMPILE_MISSING_DSRT instead. PATH PINNED: the deferred-setting check in override resolution in `dsc.dialect`, the arm for `realtime`, before the constraint check and any `.dsrt` lookup.
rules_ds:
use default:
    realtime: true
    constspace: true

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
